title: Namaz for Settling urgent Needs
introduction:
NAMAZ FOR SETTLING URGENT NEEDS

You may offer a four-unit prayer with precise Qunut and other pillars (i.e. genuflection (ruku'), prostration, and the other parts of prayers). In the first unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah one time and repeat the following verses seventy times:

In the second unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:

In the third unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:

In the fourth unit, you may recite Surah al-Faatehah once and the following verse seven times:

You may then mention your need.

verses.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the most excellent Protector.

verses.arabic: مَاشَاۤءَاللّٰهُ لَا قُوَّةَ اِلَّا بِاللهِ اِنْ تَرَنِ اَنَا اَقَلَّ مِنْكَ مَالًا وَ وَلَدًا۔
verses.translation: It is as Allah has pleased, there is no power save in Allah? If you consider me to be inferior to you in wealth and children.

verses.arabic: لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّاۤ اَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ اِنِّى كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: There is no god but You, glory be to You; surely I have been of the wrong.

verses.arabic: اُفَوِّضُ اَمْرِىْ اِلَى اللهِ اِنَّ اللهَ بَصِيْرٌ بِالْعِبَادِ۔
verses.translation: And I entrust my affair to Allah. Surely, Allah sees the servants.
